landing_point.why: Summary says 'eval() in Llama3 tool-call parsing'; the registered 'llama3' tool parser class is the obvious file and contains the only eval in tool_parsers/.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A Python-literal fallback (eval) for Qwen tool-call text in _handle_qwen_tool_result when json.loads fails.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Qwen-style outputs sometimes come out with single quotes or True/None; a maintainer adding tolerance would copy the llama3 eval pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Gemma/pythonic call-syntax parser that evaluates argument expressions instead of walking an AST.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Pythonic function-call tool formats (name(arg=...)) invite eval of the argument list; a maintainer adding the new gemma-4 support could easily take that shortcut.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Parameter value coercion via eval for non-JSON values.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: XML-ish tool formats yield string values that need type coercion; eval is a common lazy coercer.
